# Copilot Instructions for CreacionFormulariosFrontEnd

- **Project shape**: Angular 20 standalone app; routes configured in [src/app/app.routes.ts](src/app/app.routes.ts#L1-L21) with a single flow `/ver-formulario -> /ver-formulario/visor`. Providers (router, HTTP client with fetch, hydration, zone coalescing, global error handler) are wired in [src/app/app.config.ts](src/app/app.config.ts#L1-L29).
- **Domain focus**: App fetches a JSON-defined form from the backend and renders it dynamically. The fetch happens on init in [src/app/ver-formulario/ver-formulario.component.ts](src/app/ver-formulario/ver-formulario.component.ts#L1-L34), calling the service below and storing the parsed `FormularioJSONEntity` in `formulario` for children.
- **Backend integration**: [src/app/ver-formulario/ver-formulario.service.ts](src/app/ver-formulario/ver-formulario.service.ts#L1-L23) uses `HttpClient` to GET `${environment.creacionFormulariosApiUrl}/form/getFormStructure?formName=${formName}`. Base URLs and logging flags live in [src/environments/environment.ts](src/environments/environment.ts#L1-L6). Update both `environment.ts` and `environment.development.ts` when changing endpoints.
- **Dynamic rendering pipeline**: `VerFormularioComponent` owns state; child `VisorComponent` injects the parent to read `formulario` (no explicit input binding) [src/app/ver-formulario/visor/visor.component.ts](src/app/ver-formulario/visor/visor.component.ts#L1-L22). The layout flows `FormularioComponent` -> `SeccionesFormularioComponent` -> `SeccionComponent` -> `ComponentesComponent`, progressively iterating JSON to actual UI components.
- **Component registry**: `ComponentesComponent` maps `tipoComponente` strings to concrete standalone components via an `@switch` [src/app/ver-formulario/componentes/componentes.component.html](src/app/ver-formulario/componentes/componentes.component.html#L1-L121) and imports them in the TS file [src/app/ver-formulario/componentes/componentes.component.ts](src/app/ver-formulario/componentes/componentes.component.ts#L1-L120). When adding a new component type, update both the imports array and the switch cases (handle singular and array cases) to keep rendering working.
- **Section layout**: Each section distributes components into left/center/right columns (`componentesIzq`, `componentesCent`, `componentesDer`) inside an expansion panel [src/app/ver-formulario/seccion/seccion.component.html](src/app/ver-formulario/seccion/seccion.component.html#L1-L17). Sections iterate with `@for`/`@if` Angular control flow [src/app/ver-formulario/secciones-formulario/secciones-formulario.component.html](src/app/ver-formulario/secciones-formulario/secciones-formulario.component.html#L1-L8).
- **Example component**: `InPutTextComponent` initializes default values in `ngOnInit` and binds Material form field attributes directly from the entity payload [src/app/ver-formulario/in-put-text/in-put-text.component.ts](src/app/ver-formulario/in-put-text/in-put-text.component.ts#L1-L33) and template [src/app/ver-formulario/in-put-text/in-put-text.component.html](src/app/ver-formulario/in-put-text/in-put-text.component.html#L1-L12). Follow the same pattern for other controls: prefer using the entity data verbatim, and keep them standalone with the minimal Angular Material imports they need.
- **Entities**: Data contracts for dynamic rendering live under [src/app/entities/ver-formulario](src/app/entities/ver-formulario). They mirror the backend JSON structure (sections, components, attributes). Reuse them for typing rather than `any` to avoid breaking the renderer assumptions in `ComponentesComponent`.
- **Error handling**: A global error handler logs detailed traces and source hints when `enableDetailedErrorLogging` is true [src/app/utils/global-error-handler.ts](src/app/utils/global-error-handler.ts#L1-L67) and is registered in the app providers. Use `MessageUtil.buildErrorMessageFrmResponse` when surfacing backend errors to users [src/app/utils/message.util.ts](src/app/utils/message.util.ts#L1-L15).
- **State helpers**: `BaseComponentInstanceService` stores a single replaceable instance with warnings on re-creation; use it when a component should expose its instance to others without Angular DI [src/app/utils/base-component-instance.service.ts](src/app/utils/base-component-instance.service.ts#L1-L23).
- **UI library**: Angular Material is used piecemeal; import only the modules each standalone component requires (see `imports` arrays in components like [src/app/ver-formulario/seccion/seccion.component.ts](src/app/ver-formulario/seccion/seccion.component.ts#L1-L35)). New components should follow that lean import style.
- **Routing**: Default route redirects to `/ver-formulario/visor`. If a component needs `formulario`, inject `VerFormularioComponent` rather than expecting route data, or add explicit input bindings.
- **Build and run**: `npm start` / `ng serve` for dev; `npm test` for Karma tests; `npm run build` for production bundles. Prettier config lives in `package.json`; format via `npm run format` or `npm run format:check`.
- **Data flow assumptions**: Backend returns `FrmResponseEntity<string>` with `respuesta` as stringified JSON; code parses it client-side in `VerFormularioComponent`. Keep that contract or update parsing accordingly if backend changes.
- **SSR**: There is an SSR entry (`main.server.ts`, `server.ts`, `serve:ssr:CreacionFormulariosFrontEnd` script). If enabling SSR, ensure new providers are compatible with server-side execution (no direct DOM/global references).
- **Control flow syntax**: Templates use the Angular v17+ `@if/@for/@switch` syntax; maintain consistency when adding conditionals/loops.
- **Styling**: Section/component layout relies on simple flex/column classes set in the JSON (`columnClasses`, inline `style`/`styleContenedor`). Preserve these bindings so backend-driven styles apply.

If any area is unclear or missing (e.g., additional component types or backend contract details), let me know and I’ll refine these notes.
